preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the multipleBotlistAddress() function with an array containing victim addresses and set the excluded parameter to true. This will blacklist those addresses, preventing them from making transfers while the owner remains unaffected. The owner can selectively block any user's transactions at will.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is owner privilege abuse where the owner can arbitrarily blacklist addresses using the multipleBotlistAddress function. The oracle expects TokenTool._isBlacklisted[victim_address] == true, meaning we need to get an address blacklisted by exploiting the owner's privileges.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call multipleBotlistAddress to blacklist the attacker address (or a victim address).
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the owner address from the deployed contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call multipleBotlistAddress with attacker address and excluded=true. 4. Verify _isBlacklisted[attacker] is true.
